incomePathways.rationale: Conditional household-equivalent paid transitional work: alternative paid work, tax/benefit retention and positive overlap are judgments. Full incremental work/access loss applies to all funding-responsive participants, independent of clinical response.
incomePathways.counterfactual: Existing public funding, alternative paid work and other providers continue. No repeat salary or credit for the separate 88 placement cohort.
